No actions yet. I'd reply first.

---

Here's what I understand so far: the seed library lends packets to members, and you want a clearer picture of what's out and what's come back. Right now that's a shared spreadsheet with Seed, Packets, Borrower, Date out and Date back.

One thing stands out in what you pasted: about a third of the rows have no Date back. That could mean a few different things, and they'd lead to quite different tools. Maybe those seeds really haven't come back. Maybe they came back but nobody updated the sheet. Or maybe, as in a lot of seed libraries, people aren't expected to return the same packet. They grow it and bring back seeds saved from their own plants, often months later or not at all.

So "what's come back" might mean returned packets, or it might mean new seed coming in from members' harvests. That changes what we'd track: due dates and reminders, or something closer to stock levels for each variety and where the new seed came from.

Tell me if I've got any of that wrong. When someone borrows seeds from your library, what is it they're expected to bring back, and when?
